deploybot: PROD deploy started by @amanda - tag `release/3.6.0`, commit `ab12cd3`, region: us-west-2, change window: 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary=10% then ramp. :rocket:
amanda: Kicking off cutover. checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/3.6.0/checklist :eyes:
josh: I'll watch latency and error budget dashboards (APM & infra). ping me if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 220ms.
priya: confirmed DB schema NOT included in this deploy (no migrations). safe to proceed.
deploybot: Canary progress: 10% -> 25% traffic (3 containers per shard). smoke checks: OK. latency p95: 185ms, errors: 0.12%.
releasebot: release notes published: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/3.6.0 notes include model variant bump, routing adjustments.
ops-oncall: noticed a small spike on runtime-b at canary - seeing increased tail latency on tokens generating long responses. digging. :mag:
deploybot: Canary alert: runtime-b latency p99=1.2s (baseline 420ms). flag=anomaly, pausing ramp at 25%.
devops-bot: quick check - runtime-b is on kernel v2.1 and quant profile q8_fast. Suggest try rollback to previous variant `runtime-b@ab12cd2` or reduce batch_size for that shard.
amanda: Agree, do targeted rollback for runtime-b only. don't roll other services. @josh @priya ack?
josh: Ack. rolling runtime-b -> ab12cd2. I'll monitor.
deploybot: Executing partial rollback for service `runtime-b` -> commit `ab12cd2`. command: ```svcctl deploy runtime-b --commit ab12cd2 --env prod --region usw2```
deploybot: Rollback applied. runtime-b traffic shifted to stable variant. post-rollback checks: latency p95 (runtime-b) -> 410ms, errors 0.08%. Canary resumed to 50% then 100% for other services.
amanda: Thanks all. We'll pin the overall release tag but note the runtime-b revert in the changelog. leaving note in release tracker.
releasebot: Tag `release/3.6.0` pinned to commit `ab12cd3`. Post-deploy note: runtime-b rolled to `ab12cd2` due to latency regression.
deploybot: PROD deploy finished for tag `release/3.6.0` - status: succeeded with partial-service rollback. duration: ~6m. :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: Observability steady. No alerts firing after rollback. marking incident closed. :white_check_mark:
amanda: Follow-ups: add a test case for long-response tail latency in runtime-b evals, and schedule a postmortem in async channel. I'll open the ticket.
releasebot: Post-deploy summary: https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/3.6.0/summary - includes rollback details and action items.
